uniform_bn_init: initialize a BatchNorm2d layer with random uniform weights and zero bias
fixed_bn_init: initialize a BatchNorm2d layer with all ones weights and zero bias
oneone_bn_init: initialize a BatchNorm2d layer with all ones weights and all ones bias
positivenegative_bn_init: initialize a BatchNorm2d layer with weights in the range -1 to 1 and zero bias
review_bn_initializers: review the BatchNorm2d initialization functions for uniform, fixed, oneone, and positivenegative strategies
